purpose: Original Student Loan cap, books and diploma: generated grayscale albedos with original geometry and approximate authored PBR surfaces.

images.brief: Single seamless grayscale PBR base-color tile, fine premium cotton/rayon basket weave, tiny natural thread variation, orthographic macro scan style, flat even diffuse illumination, neutral mid-light grayscale for navy/emerald shader dye. Uniform scale/brightness, full square; no folds, creases, shadows, reflections, border, vignette, objects, text, logos or swatches. Restrained contrast and tactile fibers, requested 2048 square.

Single seamless grayscale leather base-color tile, fine premium goatskin bookbinding grain, small organic pebbles/hairline creases, orthographic macro scan style, flat even diffuse illumination, neutral mid-light grayscale for emerald/oxblood shader dye. Uniform scale/brightness, no border, vignette, shadows, folds, seams, wear patches, tears, text, logos, objects or swatches. Restrained contrast, requested 2048 square.

limitations: Generated albedos are not photographed scans. Micro-normal, roughness, dye, sheen and metal factors are authored approximations, not measured surface relief or reflectance. Original source images are retained unchanged. Color/roughness maps use 512px; normals are filtered and renormalized to 256px, then losslessly WebP encoded. Repeating edges, small-screen readability and final photorealism require visual review. Original authored geometry is not an exact reconstruction of the poster or an institutional credential.
